scope: Split the serial ordinary repository lane into fail-closed parallel repository, frontend, and secret-scan lanes.
Allow a Level 2 controlled-Site dispatch to reuse one exact-SHA successful pull-request ordinary Gate after machine verification.
Retain a complete Level 3 mode that runs every repository, frontend, secret, visual, and cumulative controlled-Site boundary.
Upgrade repository GitHub Actions from deprecated Node.js 20 runtimes to reviewed Node.js 24 releases.
Stabilize only the governed P0 screenshot rendering of the already-validated catalog fingerprint while retaining direct catalog integrity checks.
Fail closed when the machine-readable task manifest, controller state, requirement allocation, allowed paths, affected tests, or rollback contract disagree.
non_scope: Product behavior, public API, architecture, domain rules, permissions, ownership, Schema, migrations, or production integration.
Translation source text, direct zh or zh-TW translations, catalog generation, catalog integrity, or mixed-language PASS criteria.
Visual components, accepted Linux baselines, visual cases, thresholds, tolerances, or accessibility criteria.
Test deletion, coverage reduction, Gate relabeling, secret-scan removal, or replacement of the final Level 3 Gate.
Production ERPNext access, credentials, deployment, release, or external-system mutation.

rollback.before_product_resume: Revert only the optimization commits and restore the former serial CI workflow; no product or database rollback is required.
rollback.after_product_resume: Keep the complete Level 3 workflow available, disable only the optimized Level 2 dispatch path, and deliver a reviewed forward repair without rewriting retained evidence.
